text:
jamie: FYI noticed a billing spike for tenant org-431 after a streaming toolcall got truncated and the client retried. Looks like provisional tokens from the truncated toolcall never got reconciled, and the retry produced a confirmed entry — net double charge.

jamie: Quick log snippet:```
2026-03-22T14:18:02Z stream_id=s-902 action=toolcall chunk=8 status=truncated reason=max_tokens provisional=120 route=us-west
2026-03-22T14:18:03Z client_retry request_id=r-662 stream_id=s-902 retry_of=chunk-8 provisional=0
2026-03-22T14:18:04Z ledger:confirm request_id=r-662 tokens=240 origin=retry
```

rachel: Do we emit a provisional -> tombstone on truncation? I thought truncation flows mark provisional as aborted to avoid orphaned provisional rows.

jamie: In this case the router emitted provisional on initial chunk receipt, but truncation path returned error to client and did not emit an abort tombstone — because toolcall path bubbled an error before the abort hook ran.

tom: That sounds like an ordering hole: toolcall error handler returns to client before ledger abort completes. We should ensure abort/tombstone is persisted synchronously or at least emitted before response.

priya: Synchronous abort on hot path could add latency. Alternative: write tombstone to a fast append log and ack before returning error; a background job can compact. But append log needs to be durable enough for short window.

rachel: Another angle: change confirmed path to re-check for overlapping provisional tokens via (session_id, seq_range) and, if overlap found, merge rather than emit a new confirmed row. That acts as a defense-in-depth even if aborts are missed.

jamie: We already have a small overlap check but it assumes provisional entries are marked `aborted=true` or `confirmed_ref`. In this incident the provisional remained open so the overlap check didn't trigger.

tom: Could we add a short-lived provisional TTL (e.g., 30s) where provisional entries older than TTL are considered stale and not credited when a confirm comes later? But that might break long-lived resumable sessions.

priya: TTL is risky. Some workflows legitimately pause >30s. I prefer making the confirm path idempotent: when writing confirmed_tokens, attempt to find provisional ranges with matching client-trace+seq and atomically mark them confirmed, decrementing the net charge. If none found, still write confirmed but tag for reconciliation.

rachel: For reconciliation: add a nightly job to scan confirmed rows with overlapping provisional for same session but provisional not flagged confirmed; create adjustment entries to neutralize duplicates and emit alerts to billing.

jamie: Console fix: in request trace view show a "truncation events" band and display any pending provisional tombstones. Right now users see two entries and are confused. UX mock: collapsible timeline, provisional in orange, confirms in green, tombstones in gray.

billing-bot: alert: org-431 2026-03-22 provisional_orphan_count=14 projected_refund=0.0043 USD

tom: Rollout plan: 1) Make abort emission synchronous in the toolcall error path for 2 weeks behind feature flag 2) augment confirm writer with overlap-merge logic (feature flag) 3) add reconciliation job and console timeline (non-breaking) 4) flip flags after canary.

priya: Index note: confirm writer's overlap query must use indexes on (client_trace, seq_start, seq_end) otherwise confirmations will slow. Add composite index before enabling merge.

jamie: Immediate mitigation: run ad-hoc reconcile for org-431 and credit them; CS already opened a ticket.

rachel: Tests: unit test for toolcall error ordering, integration test simulating KV eviction + truncation + retry, and end-to-end billing smoke for canary orgs.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy: toolcall-abort-sync feature-flag -> canary in 45m :rocket:

jamie: Also a note: client libs should avoid automatic immediate retry after truncation; they should surface truncation to app layer so devs decide whether to retry. Add a client warning in SDK docs.

priya: I'll draft the DB index patch and reconciliation job RFC. tom, can you pick up the abort ordering fix?

tom: On it. Will add unit tests and coordinate with priya on the index rollout timing.

jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll post the org-431 reconcile PR and the console mock in the RFC thread. :eyes:
